invariants.rule: A lineage/subspecies stores an exact parent SpeciesDefinition identity/version reference and deltas; it never copies the complete parent record.
Lineage/subspecies/variant relationships require explicit source-backed evidence; names, document co-location, dataset membership or visual similarity are insufficient.
Given identical exact-version base/lineage inputs and source-backed operations, stable ordering makes the definition-level composition replayable.
Ordering establishes replay sequence only; colliding replacements/overrides are not resolved by last-write-wins, lineage name or layer order unless an explicit authoritative conflict rule says so.
Missing parent versions, unknown targets, incompatible deltas and unresolved collisions remain explicit conflict records rather than guessed outcomes.
Duplicate grants and stacking, suppression, replacement or magnitude semantics remain with the owning shared mechanic/rules profile.
Lineage/subspecies composition does not replace or erase the selected base species identity/history.
MVPS-08 does not own form/transformation runtime, species progression events or active runtime contribution/grant receipts; those remain MVPS-09, MVPS-10 and MVPS-13.
